1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Fi (Fotograf)

(Jabatan Penerangan Malaysia) 2024.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 9 Ogos 2024.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Perintah ini—

"fotograf" ertinya fotograf dalam bentuk digital;

"Ketua Pengarah" ertinya Ketua Pengarah Jabatan Penerangan Malaysia.

Fi dan pembayaran fi

3. Fi yang ditetapkan dalam ruang (3), (4) dan (5) Jadual hendaklah dibayar kepada

Ketua Pengarah bagi pembelian fotograf mengikut kategori pembeli

yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) dan kategori fotograf yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (2).

Peremitan fi

4. Ketua Pengarah boleh meremitkan fi yang ditetapkan di bawah Perintah ini

sama ada secara keseluruhan atau sebahagian, secara am atau dalam mana-mana hal

atau kelas hal yang tertentu.

FEES ACT 1951

FEES (PHOTOGRAPH) (DEPARTMENT OF INFORMATION MALAYSIA) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 3 and 10 of the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209],

the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Fees (Photograph)

(Department of Information Malaysia) Order 2024.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 9 August 2024.

Interpretation

2. In this Order—

"photograph" means a photograph in a digital form;

"Director General" means the Director General of the Department

of Information Malaysia.

Fees and payment of fees

3. The fees prescribed in column (3), (4) and (5) of the Schedule shall be paid

to the Director General for the purchase of a photograph in accordance with

the category of purchasers specified in column (1) and the category of photographs

specified in column (2).

Remission of fees

4. The Director General may remit the fees prescribed under this Order either wholly

or in part, generally or in any particular case or class of cases.

2. For the purposes of this Schedule—

(a) "regular photograph" means a photograph purchased within the period

of five years from the date of the photograph's coverage;

(b) "exclusive photograph" means a photograph of national leaders,

National Monument or national landmarks;

(c) "historical photograph" means a photograph purchased more than the

period of five years from the date of the photograph's coverage.
